t: In front of you is Two Piece Reclining Figure No. 1, a sculpture by Henry Moore, catalogued as being at Chelsea College of Art and Design. Moore is best known for his semi-abstract monumental bronze sculptures, which are displayed as public art around the world. This is one of them, standing at an art college. He also made many drawings, including a series showing Londoners sheltering from the Blitz during the Second World War.
